title: Cloud workers on the default sdk0 substrate are not WorkerAgents
body:
WorkerAgent hosting (xd3) applies only to runs on the do_v1 substrate: FactorySandboxEnv needs FactorySandbox's run door, which the Sandbox SDK 0.x class does not have. Every run submitted without substrate do_v1 still runs the pi-CLI all-in-one worker, so [A1] holds only once do_v1 is the default (umq) or the 0.x path gains a run door.
evidence: cloudflare/src/worker-agent.ts workerAgentsFromEnv (record.substrate !== DO_V1 returns null)
